build.buildCommand: rm -rf dist && npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: mkdir -p /app/uploads/general /app/uploads/stories /app/uploads/programs /app/uploads/team /app/uploads/avatars /app/uploads/uploads /app/uploads/lostfound /app/uploads/videos /app/uploads/images && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma generate && npm start
